_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Archive Distribution profile UML. Aligned to metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifManifest/. Describes a DataDownload whose schema:hasPart enumerates ArchivePart component files (each schema:MediaObject) inside an archive; parts may carry size, checksum, sidecar back-references, AND data-description physical mappings (the part is itself a tabular or structured data file). Standalone module; composes: []. Restored content from the resolvedSchema: physical mapping family (AbstractMapping with PhysicalMapping / TextMapping / LocatorMapping), physical dataset family (AbstractDataSet with TabularTextDataSet / StructuredDataSet variants and their text / numeric format attributes), and DefinedTerm.

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF Archive Distribution Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Archive Distribution Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Archive distribution: hasPart -> ArchivePart; per-part physical mappings + dataset co-typing
targetModel.definition: CDIF Archive Distribution profile module. On any Dataset whose catalog record declares conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/manifest/1.0, schema:distribution items that are schema:DataDownloads MAY carry schema:hasPart describing the component files inside an archive. Each ArchivePart can itself carry cdif:hasPhysicalMapping and the cdi: physical-dataset co-typing (TabularTextDataSet / StructuredDataSet) when it is a tabular or structured data file.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Archive distribution structure: component files inside a single download.

package.name: Distribution
package.definition: Physical mapping family (AbstractMapping / PhysicalMapping / TextMapping / LocatorMapping) + physical dataset family (AbstractDataSet / TabularTextDataSet / StructuredDataSet) carried by an ArchivePart when it is a tabular or structured data file.

package.name: Concepts
package.definition: schema:DefinedTerm reference target (used by encoding-format-related controlled-vocabulary properties).

package.name: DataTypes
package.definition: Inline value-object datatypes: QuantitativeValue (file size), Checksum (spdx).

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of CDIFCore classes attached to (Dataset / CatalogRecord / DataDownload).

class.definition: Stub of schema:Dataset (full definition in CDIFCore).
Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord. For manifest, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/manifest/1.0.
Stub of CDIFCore::DataDownload. Carries schema:hasPart when the file is an archive.

attribute.name: encodingFormat
attribute.definition: schema:encodingFormat - including 'application/zip' triggers the hasPart requirement.

class._comment: ArchivePart - schema:MediaObject component file inside an archive.
class.definition: A component file within an archive distribution. Typed schema:MediaObject. May itself carry cdif:hasPhysicalMapping and the cdi: physical-dataset co-typing when the part is a tabular or structured data file.
schema:QuantitativeValue - numeric value with unit, used for schema:size on an ArchivePart.
spdx:Checksum - inline checksum payload on an ArchivePart.

class._comment: schema:DefinedTerm - referenced for controlled-vocabulary encoding-format terms.
class.definition: schema:DefinedTerm - a term from a controlled vocabulary (DefinedTermSet).

class._comment: AbstractMapping - abstract supertype for cdif:hasPhysicalMapping items.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for the cdif:hasPhysicalMapping family. Concrete subtypes: PhysicalMapping / TextMapping / LocatorMapping.

class._comment: PhysicalMapping - generic per-field mapping with numeric-format attributes.
class.definition: Generic per-field physical mapping with column index, format, and numeric-format details.
Per-field mapping for delimited or fixed-width text.

class._comment: LocatorMapping - structured-data per-field mapping via locator expression.
class.definition: Per-field mapping for structured / hierarchical data.

class._comment: AbstractDataSet - abstract supertype for cdi:PhysicalDataSet co-types an ArchivePart may carry.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for cdi:TabularTextDataSet / cdi:StructuredDataSet co-types.

class._comment: TabularTextDataSet - delimited / fixed-width text part with full layout attributes.
class.definition: ArchivePart co-typed cdi:TabularTextDataSet. Carries CSV-style layout attributes.

association.definition: schema:hasPart - component files inside this archive.

association._comment: ArchivePart -> AbstractMapping via cdif:hasPhysicalMapping (when the part is a tabular or structured data file).
association.definition: cdif:hasPhysicalMapping - per-field physical mappings for the part's variables.

association._comment: ArchivePart -> AbstractDataSet via the cdi: physical-dataset co-typing.
association.definition: Co-typing: an ArchivePart MAY also be typed cdi:TabularTextDataSet or cdi:StructuredDataSet.
